projects.title: Zelly
projects.description: Developed and deployed a full-stack e-commerce platform following the MVC architecture for Textiles and Footware shops, featuring JWT and Google OAuth authentication, Razorpay payment integration, and RESTful APIs. Implemented key e-commerce features including product variants such as sizes, referral rewards, offers, coupons, and admin product management. Designed the application with a focus on scalability, security, and maintainability, and deployed it on AWS EC2.

projects.title: FitZelly
projects.description: Designed and developed a multi-tenant gym management SaaS application with separate portals for gym owners, clients, trainers, and superadmins, utilizing role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure secure and tailored user experiences. Built the frontend with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, and the backend with Node.js, MongoDB, and Redis following Clean Architecture principles. Implemented JWT authentication with role-based authorization, integrated Stripe for payment processing, and enabled real-time chat and notifications using WebSockets. Deployed the application using Docker Compose on AWS EC2 for the backend and Vercel for the frontend.

projects.title: Bro Blog
projects.description: Designed and developed a blog management platform that enables users to create, edit, and manage blog posts with a secure and structured content management workflow. Built the frontend with React and the backend with Express.js, following the Repository Pattern and SOLID principles, with PostgreSQL as the relational database. Implemented JWT authentication and role-based authorization to ensure secure access control, and developed RESTful APIs for efficient content management. Deployed the frontend on Vercel and the backend on Render.

projects.title: PDF Extractor
projects.description: Designed and developed a PDF manipulation platform that allows users to upload PDF files, select and rearrange pages, and download the modified document. Built the frontend with Next.js and the backend with Nest.js, following the Repository Pattern and SOLID principles for maintainable and scalable architecture. Implemented JWT authentication and integrated the Brevo email service for OTP-based user authentication and account verification. Deployed the frontend on Vercel and the backend on Render.
